note: FILM_BOARD.csv (user, 2026-11): 15 fixed boards of 4 roles, one of each road per board; each role belongs to exactly one road (its highest style probability, main 55 / others 15 placeholder). Wants, style numbers are placeholders. 1 tag small, 2 tags medium, 2-3 tags big. opponents: `draw` = the two-step opponent draw (defaults.audition_opponent), `named` = the fixed star of the big second match. heroine: "" none, "unnamed", "draw" (medium pool, defaults.heroine) or an npc id | heroine "duo" = two male leads (user, 2026-11): no heroine; the co-star mini game is played with the opponent of the deciding match (the player is the lead when he wins the audition, the opponent is the lead when the player takes the part after a 2:3), only when that opponent is a named star. Every medium film draws a heroine and an opponent

roles.name: 小人国之恐怖
roles.style_rule: 60% on the player's current highest-reputation road, the other three colors share the rest; the rival is a level-2 unnamed actor

board.morals_note: step 12c: no big film for morals_months months after an arrest or an unsuppressed scandal

talkie.note: FILM_BOARD (user): talkies start on the 1927-11 board (1 role); from 1928-03 30%; from the 1928-07 board every role (full talkie)

shoot.note: GDD 5.6. Performance P is an integer scaled x1000: 500 + successful days x 500 / shooting days + bonus skill x 2 (+ stunt_self), clamped to 500-1200
shoot.fee_note: User (lover playtest): the fee is paid at the end of shooting and set by the audition, not by the release: base x fee_by_lost_rounds[rounds the rival won in the deciding match]% (3:0 125, 3:1 100, 3:2 80); a supporting part is still x40%. Bases small 80 / medium 300 / big 1200 (about one period of the best job of that time per shooting period; the release dividend S x 2 comes on top)

release.note: GDD 8. S is an integer scaled x1000: B x P x F x T / 10^6
release.rep_table_note: Step 12c c3 round 5 (GDD 8): X = S / B; hit X >= hit_pct% (a number, or by size), normal X >= fail_pct%, poor X >= flop_pct%, flop below; the reputation change of the film's road by band and size (support x release_pct)
release.undefined_note: Placeholder 6: the number of kinds is still to be confirmed with the user (all 13 tags below 4 and at least this many kinds counted)

placeholder_gen.note: Placeholder roles generated when the role pool runs out (rarely needed once PLAN steps 16-17 fill the pool). Style: main color 55, others 15; wants = one random skill of the main color's road; tag = a random tag of the main color's set; the big film's second-round named rival is drawn by weight from the 3 highest-level present rivals of the main color

defaults.fame_gate_note: User (lover playtest): fame formula unchanged; gates set by estimate so a good start can try a medium film from 1925-03 and a big film from 1927 (medium 130/130/140/150/160/170, big 210 to 1927, then 240, 270). Placeholder, to be re-measured

audition_curve.note: Switch (user, 2026-11). enabled true: medium/big fame gates by year from fame_gate below (the per-role fame_gate is ignored); unnamed rivals' main level = player_level of the year + random offset by tier; named rivals keep their own colors, k, habit and fame, but their main color is pulled into player_level + named_band and their second color is at least main - named_side_gap. enabled false: the old rules (per-role gates; unnamed levels by level_up_months in rivals.json; named rivals as listed). All numbers are a first draft to confirm with the user | User (2026-11): the fame gates are the per-role values again (medium 130/130/140/150/160/170 by board year, big 210 to 1927, 240, 270; sign-up attribute gates by road and year); the year table is kept in fame_gate_curve_unused and `fame_gate` is empty so it does nothing
audition_curve.fixed_offset_note: Unnamed rivals (small, medium, big first match): level = player_level of the year + this fixed offset, no random (the midpoint of `offset`, rounded down). Fame is base + per_half_year as before

audition_opponent.note: Medium films and the first match of a big film (user, 2026-11): roll named_pct for a named male star, else an unnamed rival. Named: the stars present this month (the big film leaves out its second-match star), weight = the star's weights[phase][0] for medium, [1] for a big first match; phases early 1924-25, mid 1926-27, late 1928-29. The second match of a big film is the fixed star on the role.

heroine.note: Medium film heroine "draw" (user, 2026-11): every attainable actress present this month goes in one pool, no road or rotation; weight = her weights[phase] (> 0 whenever present), plus tag_bonus when any of her tags is one of the role's tags. Big films have a fixed heroine or none; small films none

defaults.special_tags_note: Special production tags are counted apart (st.tags.underground, count.lowbudget); they do not use the regular tag slots of a role and are not among the 13 regular tags

costar.note: Co-star mini game (user, 2026-11): once per film, first shooting period, only with a named heroine. She holds main_cards cards of her main road and the rest of her second road (levels of the year, second_gap lower); 3 rounds; a round scores 1 for the same color, 1 for the same number, x2 when both. P + score x per_point after the clamp (max 12 x 15 = 180, about +0.18); her favor + score x favor_per_point. Numbers are placeholders

board_note: Fixed boards (user): slots big, medium, medium2 (boards 8-15 have two medium films), small, small2 (boards 1-7 have two small films). reserve_pool is empty now (rapport extra roles come from the generated placeholder roles when the pool needs them)
